signature:

    Lemmatheca.ProofTheory.CodingFormalProofs.certificateCheck
        Lemmatheca.ProofTheory.CodingFormalProofs.arithmeticSignature
        Lemmatheca.ProofTheory.ArithmeticProofPredicates.paAxiomCertificate p a =
